passages.text: And be not afraid of the words of a sinful man; for his glory shall be dung and worms. To-day he shall be lifted up, and to-morrow he shall in no wise be found, because he is returned to his dust, and his thought is perished.
passages.note: Fear of a powerful or threatening person; their power passes

passages.text: And Judas said, It is an easy thing for many to be shut up in the hands of a few; and with heaven it is all one, to save by many or by few: for victory in battle stands not in the multitude of an army; but strength is from heaven.
passages.note: Feeling outnumbered or outmatched; courage against odds
